verdict.rationale: Recruitee documents an authenticated company API covering core ATS objects: listing and creating candidates, adding candidate profile fields, creating job offers and talent pools, and reading departments and locations. Webhooks add outbound event callbacks. The evidence does not show API parity with the UI's breadth, and the Careers API token is explicitly limited to a few offer and application endpoints. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, documented API coverage of UI features such as eSignatures and offer letters, referrals, agency management, WhatsApp and texting, email, scheduling, templates, reporting, onboarding and team management, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: a client (any application that would like to use the API) needs to authenticate first with a header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
Manually add candidate to your account.
Calling this endpoint will return a collection of the company's candidates.
Create a company offer (job or talent pool).
Allows to add profile fields to a candidate with provided ID.
The token only covers the endpoints mentioned in the documentation: /offers /offers/:id /offers/:offer_slug/candidates
